manifest.description: ★ KEYSTONE. Decompose a multi-clause atom-tag-dispatch function (def/defp foo(:tag, ...) clauses) into per-tag submodules with a generated router on the parent, via the split_elixir_clauses_by_tag plan kind. Replaces 100+ clauses with focused per-domain modules; preserves clause order, guards verbatim, and duplicate-tag groups.
when_to_use: an Elixir def/defp has 30+ clauses, each pattern-matching on a leading atom tag (typically a struct field like %Op{kind: :tag})
operator has identified a partition (e.g. op_runtime.ex with 158 :kind clauses → {Entity: [...], Explain: [...], Author: [...]})
the function name + arity is stable across all clauses (mixed arity → split each arity separately)
anti_patterns: do not use to *decide* a partition — chain elixir-module-dependency-graph or operator review first
do not use when source clauses require duplicate-tag subkey discrimination (v2 only)
do not pass dispatch_pattern that doesn't match the source (cross-check via elixir-genserver-state-audit when shape is GenServer-flavored)
operator-authority acknowledgments (use_at_scope, defmacro_move, quote_in_moved, unpreservable_guards, dynamic_dispatch) MUST be operator-supplied — atoms NEVER default them

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-shatter-dispatch-table. Charter: split a multi-clause atom-tag-dispatch function into per-tag submodules.

Protocol:
1. Ground: bbox_code_symbols(project_dir="{{project_dir}}", query="{{module_name}}", languages=["elixir"]). Confirm the function exists with the declared arity and that every primary tag in {{partition}} maps to a real clause.
2. Plan: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="split_elixir_clauses_by_tag", deep_analysis=true, source="{{source}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", item_names={{item_names}}, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={...}).
   Inspect: partitions[].captured_helpers, shared_helpers, dynamic_dispatch_unresolved, duplicate_tag_groups, guarded_clauses, unenumerated_tags. roundtrip_check is deferred to apply (EX-V6).
3. Refuse on: unenumerated_tags (exhaustive), duplicate_tag_split_across_buckets, guarded_clauses_require_review (unless acknowledged), dynamic_dispatch_in_moved_clauses (unless acknowledged), defmacro_move/quote_in_moved/use_at_scope (unless acknowledged), unknown_tag_in_partition.
4. Apply (if inputs.apply): bbox_refactor_run(dispatch_origin="agent", confirm=true, steps=[<plan>, {"op":"command","command":"mix","args":["compile","--warnings-as-errors","--return-errors"],"capture":"mix_diag","on_failure":"continue_for_repair"}, {"op":"plan","kind":"elixir_compile_fix_round","diagnostics_ref":"last"}, {"op":"command","command":"mix","args":["compile","--warnings-as-errors"],"required":true}, {"op":"command","command":"mix","args":["format","--check-formatted"],"required":true}, {"op":"command","command":"mix","args":["test","--max-failures","1"],"required":true}]).
5. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<bucket count, clause counts per bucket, helper counts, fixme count, compile/test result>).

Strict rules:
- Never default operator-authority acknowledgments.
- Never invoke with v2-only inputs (explicit_subkeys, cross-arg discriminators).
- Never apply when plan_status=blocked.

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{module_name}} {{item_names}} {{arity}} {{head_matcher}} {{partition}} {{selection_mode}} {{duplicate_tag_policy}} {{target_dir}} {{router_module}} {{acknowledge_quote_in_moved}} {{acknowledge_use_at_scope}} {{acknowledge_defmacro_move}} {{acknowledge_unpreservable_guards}} {{acknowledge_dynamic_dispatch}} {{apply}} {{validation_cmd}}
